Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

DataEntry 1.2.1

  • Replace the full-page waiter loader with a smaller shinycssloaders grid spinner, removing its JavaScript bundle and the wait for unrelated Shiny work at startup.
  • Show “Validating data…” immediately on Save. Keep duplicate-click protection and clear the feedback on completion or disconnect.
  • Keep the data visible during refreshes and show Save feedback with a larger spinner at the upper center of the page. Block mouse and keyboard interaction during validation and saving while keeping the data visible.
  • Remove an unused Google Fonts stylesheet that could hold up page rendering on slow connections; retain the existing system font.

DataEntry 1.2.0

  • Show a full-page loading spinner until the grid is ready in all data-entry editors, including on slow connections.
  • Show immediate feedback when Save is clicked and block repeated clicks while saving. Clear the spinner when processing finishes, including validation failures and save errors, or when the connection is lost.
  • Add waiter to Imports.

DataEntry 1.1.0

  • Load validators from inspector.R in the app directory when present, taking precedence over inspector definitions stored in the database.
  • Preserve the existing execution timeout and validation error handling for file-based inspectors.
